feed.title: NPR Topics: News
feed.subtitle: Breaking news, top national and world stories, politics, business and culture from NPR. Catch up on demand with NPR News Now, Up First and Consider This.

entry.title: Following big Democratic wins, these swing voters are looking for results
entry.summary: For the swing voters NPR is regularly checking in with as part of its Swing Shift series, the election results brought mixed emotions, as does the pending Democratic control of Congress.

entry.title: Russia and Ukraine agree to a large exchange of prisoners of war, officials say
entry.summary: Russia and Ukraine have agreed to a large exchange of prisoners of war. U.S.-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi led to this decision, marking the biggest humanitarian release since the war began in 2022.

entry.title: House effectively ends Hegseth impeachment. And, 3 men accused of plotting U.K. attacks
entry.summary: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth has been spared from the House's impeachment effort, at least for now. And, federal prosecutors arrested three men accused of being Iran-backed operatives.

entry.title: Iran-backed trio accused of plotting attacks on U.K. base hosting U.S. jets
entry.summary: Iran-backed operatives have been charged over nearly 20 attacks, including a plot on a U.K. base housing U.S. troops. Separately, a U.S. soldier is held in the U.K. on Russia spying claims.

entry.title: Morning News Brief: Hegseth impeachment, new House GOP leader, UK probes base plot
entry.summary: Republicans block Hegseth impeachment, Trump ally picked to lead House GOP minority, UK investigates alleged Iran-backed plot.

entry.title: Both sides now? Critics slam DOJ moves to dismiss convictions of Trump allies
entry.summary: The DOJ moved to dismiss criminal convictions of former Trump adviser Steve Bannon and of the Oath Keepers, in what it calls "the interests of justice." Critics are crying foul.

entry.title: Volunteer musicians play songs for veterans who are hospitalized
entry.summary: Volunteer musicians play for veterans and others who are hospitalized. They're part of Musicians On Call, a group that spreads the healing power of music.

entry.title: Oil giant ExxonMobil left Venezuela years ago. Now it's considering a return
entry.summary: ExxonMobil has signed a memorandum of understanding with the Venezuelan government and its state-owned oil company to explore opportunities in the country.

entry.title: U.S. officials look to Europe to learn how to make prison better
entry.summary: American prison officials are looking to European nations like Germany and Norway for a roadmap on how to design a prison that emphasizes rehabilitation and a successful return to life on the outside.

entry.title: New recipes and decorating ideas to try this Thanksgiving
entry.summary: Whether you're hosting friendsgiving or Thanksgiving, we've got foolproof turkey recipes, advice on how to stay present while hosting, and directions on how to create a stunning floral arrangement.
